task_name: Trades close source recognition and legitimate exceptions
prompt: Review the contract, payroll, supplier cutoff, noncash transfer and loan source facts in trades_close_recognition_sources.xlsx. Distinguish supported corrections from missing information, reconstruct the stated incentive basis and explain the accounting and cash-flow effects. Preserve legitimate exceptions and state the remaining close limits.

rubric.description: Retains October labor $3,500.00 already booked and corrects its unpaid offset with debit Prepaids / credit supplier liability $3,500.00; no added cost.
Pairs the November offset reversal; October assets and liabilities each increase $3,500.00 and profit/cash effect is $0.00.
From retained March-September basis derives revenue bonus $15,127.03, EBITDA bonus $483.57 and total formula entitlement $15,610.60.
Uses cumulative positive pre-bonus EBITDA from the contracted earned start; separate May payout is excluded, not deducted, and negative cumulative EBITDA contributes zero.
October exact true-up remains unmeasured until cumulative sources and prior net formula recognition are reconciled; isolated monthly EBITDA and cash payouts do not prove entitlement.
Explains the $239.54 balanced card reclass and resulting -$5,019.62 adjusted Card A movement and $0.00 Card B movement; no correction or new cash is warranted.
Classifies June $15,000.00 proceeds and July -$15,000.00 repayment as financing, not operating; maturity does not alter cash nature.
Does not plug WIP or costs to a target margin, mandate reversal of supported cumulative balances, or turn an assigned reviewer into actual human approval.
